steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, delete all the calendar events on 2023-10-25
Execute: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i calendar

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm list packages | grep -i calendar"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id,title,dtstart,dtend --where "dtstart>=1698192000000 AND dtstart<1698278400000"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id,title,dtstart,dtend --where "dtstart>=1698192000000 AND dtstart<1698278400000""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell 'content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id,title,dtstart,dtend' | head -50

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell 'content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection _id,title,dtstart,dtend' | head -50"
